styles.name: Defter
styles.note: A hand-ruled ledger page — cream paper, pencil-thin hex lines, nothing painted.

styles.name: Çini
styles.note: Deep indigo and white, bordered like Iznik tilework — handsome, but reads as decor before it reads as a game.

styles.name: Pazar
styles.note: The striped market awning first appears here — the motif that survived even though the counter underneath did not.

styles.name: Buzdolabı
styles.note: Steel-blue and frosted, a refrigerator door's worth of magnets — too cold for a food fight.

styles.name: Tezgah
styles.note: Warm plank counter, worn brass — the direction that named the studio and shipped as the board itself.

styles.name: Ocak
styles.note: Charcoal and ember glow, a cooktop grate for a board — striking, but every card fights the dark for attention.

styles.name: Neon
styles.note: Synthwave arcade cabinet, glowing grid lines — a different game's clothes on this one's roster.
